_README: Per-project progress state. Fetch this FIRST before any work on the project; the assistant outputs an updated copy at every step boundary and the USER pushes it. Never trust the chat scroll — trust this file plus the DB.
notes:
One of the oldest fleet sites — predates state.json/article-list.json conventions; both retrofitted 2026-09-10. facts.json is a pipeline-standard copy of FINAL.json (untouched, kept as history). Live GSC audit (2026-09-10, same day): sitemap resubmitted, re-read by Google, 114 pages discovered; the indexing report itself lags ~5-6 days behind and hadn't caught up yet at check time — expected, not a new issue.

RETROFIT IN PROGRESS (user request, 2026-09-10): initial local-file-based estimate said 82 articles averaging 436 words — WRONG, see retrofit.article_list_correction. The real live count is 84 articles averaging ~668 words at the time of the first full re-export (before batch-01/02 landed), because a prior disconnected session had already expanded 8 categories without updating local files. Zero articles had an in-body image at retrofit start; no vein/swamp data existed. Ran the synthesis audit for real (not assumed from SKILL.md's cautionary note) — HEADROOM 6.2 (STRONG) on 4 named themes (jr-pass, ic-card, city-sequencing, seasonal-timing); only 1 article (how-to-plan-first-japan-itinerary) joined all 4 at audit time — that's the pre-join that was trimmed during batch-01. article-list.json (schema_version 5) carries the full swamp+vein retrofit tagging for all 84 articles (6 swamps, 4 vein pieces — all 4 now have a dedicated turn article after best-time-to-visit-japan was found and tagged).

INFRA NOTES (found during batch-01 pilot, now resolved/documented): admin.japanforamericans.com does not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN) — use https://japanforamericans-admin.vercel.app/ instead (see memory). common.facts scope for this site is 'japan' (SITE.dbSchema in packages/config/site.ts), NOT 'japanforamericans' — confirmed by reading packages/db/common.ts factScopes(). Fixed a real bug in scripts/upload-batch.mjs (site repo): it derived in-body image targets from a.html (field doesn't exist — always silently matched nothing) instead of a.content, and expected literal ids already in the body instead of <!-- IMAGE_SLOT_n --> markers — in-body image upload had never worked on this site. Fixed to scan content for IMAGE_SLOT_n and derive '<slug>-<n>'; added --body-only flag to skip re-uploading unchanged heroes on a retrofit pass. content/ moved from the site repo to travel-facts/japanforamericans/content/ on the volume (site repo's content/ is gitignored/working-only) — see memory: content-lives-on-volume. hero-images/ and body-images/ are now separate subfolders per batch, not one shared images/.

NOT a new-content pass — every slug already exists and stays published throughout (articles-batch.mjs update preserves status by default).

retrofit.pre_join_fix_note: batch-05 fixed the real pre-join violation the audit found: how-to-plan-first-japan-itinerary, japan-itinerary-ideas, and 1-week-in-japan-itinerary all used to explain JR Pass economics + IC card setup + seasonal timing in full, alongside city-sequencing, in the same article (the exact pre-join SKILL.md warned about). Verified mechanically (2-sentence-window join scan) after every edit, not just by eye.
